newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, losses among hoteliers.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, losses among hoteliers.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed on Tuesday with losses among hoteliers and gains in blue chips.
* Seven of 14 actively traded stocks rose, six fell and one was flat.
* Turnover plunged to 8.3 million kuna and volume slightly smaller at 10,143 shares.
* Most actively traded stock was fully listed Zagrebacka Banka which added 54 kuna to 1,890, selling 2,799 shares.
* Biggest gainer was hotelier Zlatni Rat, last traded in October 1996, doubling its value to 220 kuna. Only ten shares changed hands.
* Leading decliner was hotelier Riviera, down 7.3 percent to 204 kuna with 410 shares sold.
